'''Swamp rancor''' was a [[Subspecies/Legends|sub-species]] of [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] living in [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. Their notable difference from common rancors were the two large horns on their head, as well as a darker shade of skin. They could be found in the [[Endless Swamp]] on [[Zakuul]], the capital world of the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Swamp rancors appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' in the Zakuul swamp.
